instructions: Zotero is the user's reference manager: papers, books and other sources, with PDFs/files, annotations, notes, collections and tags. Tools run against the local Zotero app (started if not running) and target My Library unless given a libraryID from zotero_status. Mutating calls ask for permission in Zotero unless already granted, and each call is one Edit → Undo step (undoing additions moves them to the trash).

tools.name: zotero_status
tools.title: Zotero status
tools.description: Check that Zotero is reachable and get its version, libraries (with libraryIDs) and granted permissions. Call when other tools fail.

tools.name: zotero_get_item_types
tools.title: Get Zotero item types
tools.description: Get valid fields and creator types for item types, by the names zotero_add_items, zotero_update_items and zotero_change_item_types take.

baseFields.description: Type-specific field → base field (e.g. bookTitle → publicationTitle); accepted by zotero_update_items

tools.name: zotero_search
tools.title: Search Zotero
tools.description: Find items by Advanced Search conditions. For free text, use titleCreatorYear, anyField or fulltextContent with contains. Child matches return their parent item unless a condition is itemType is note, attachment or annotation.

condition.description: Item field (zotero_get_item_types), creator type, tag, note, annotation, count, etc.

operator.description: Valid operators vary by condition; errors list them

value.description: Omit for isEmpty/isNotEmpty. itemType: from zotero_get_item_types or note/attachment/annotation. Dates: 2020, 2020-05-01, or '7 days' (isInTheLast). collection/savedSearch: key. annotationType: highlight, underline, note, text, image, ink. fileType: pdf, ebook, document, image, audio, video, presentation, webpage. attachmentStorageType: storedFile, linkedFile, webLink. annotationColor: hex.

mode.description: For fulltextContent: regexp, regexpCS (case-sensitive), or phraseBinary (also non-text files)

level.description: Match only on children of this kind
Match all conditions on the same child

conditions.description: All must match; omit for all items in scope.

collectionKey.description: Limit to this collection. Not with savedSearchKey.

savedSearchKey.description: Limit to this saved search. Not with collectionKey.

inTrash.description: Search only the trash. Not with collectionKey or savedSearchKey.

sortDirection.description: Default: desc for dates, asc otherwise

tools.name: zotero_get_items
tools.title: Get Zotero items
tools.description: Get full item data in Zotero web API JSON, with attachments and notes. Trashed items have deleted: true.

items.description: Web API item JSON plus these fields

path.description: Local file path, if on this computer

tools.name: zotero_list_duplicates
tools.title: List duplicate Zotero items
tools.description: List duplicate item sets (same DOI/ISBN, or similar title, creators and close years), oldest first in each set. Verify a set is one work (not e.g. preprint vs published) before zotero_merge_items.

tools.name: zotero_add_items
tools.title: Add items to Zotero
tools.description: Add items and look for their PDFs/EPUBs (for BibTeX/RIS/etc., use zotero_import). Prefer identifiers (DOIs, ISBNs, arXiv/PubMed IDs, or URLs containing one) over item JSON; other web pages must be saved with the Zotero Connector. By default, runs Find Full Text locally so institutional access works.

items.description: Zotero web API item JSON (see zotero_get_item_types for valid fields/creatorTypes). Existing-item properties (key, collections, parentItem, etc.) are ignored; use collectionKey. For notes/files, use zotero_add_note / zotero_add_attachment.

results.description: In input order (one identifier can yield several)

path.description: Local file path, if on this computer

tools.name: zotero_update_items
tools.title: Update Zotero items
tools.description: Update items' fields, creators, tags and collections (atomic: one invalid change fails the call). To change itemType, use zotero_change_item_types.

changes.description: One object per item: key, fields to set at top level (zotero_get_item_types; "" clears a field), plus any properties below.

name.description: Single-field name (e.g. organization), instead of firstName/lastName

removeFromCollections.description: Collection keys to remove from (keeps item in library)

tools.name: zotero_change_item_types
tools.title: Change Zotero item types
tools.description: Change regular items' types (atomic). Shared fields stay; fields with a counterpart move by baseFields (zotero_get_item_types); dropped fields are returned with their values. Use zotero_update_items to fill new fields.

tools.name: zotero_merge_items
tools.title: Merge duplicate Zotero items
tools.description: Merge duplicate regular items of the same type. Master keeps its fields and absorbs the others' notes, files, annotations, tags, collections and relations (combining duplicate PDFs); others go to trash. Set fields from another copy with zotero_update_items first.

masterKey.description: Item to keep (one of itemKeys; default: oldest)

tools.name: zotero_list_collections
tools.title: List Zotero collections
tools.description: List collections (or a collection's subcollections at any depth) with item counts. Use zotero_search for a collection's items.

tools.name: zotero_add_collection
tools.title: Create a Zotero collection
tools.description: Create a collection (top-level or nested). Use zotero_update_items to add items.

tools.name: zotero_update_collection
tools.title: Update a Zotero collection
tools.description: Rename a collection or move it to another parent (or top level). Use zotero_trash to delete.

parentCollection.description: New parent key, or null for top level

tools.name: zotero_list_tags
tools.title: List Zotero tags
tools.description: List tags with item counts, colored tags (number keys) first.

tools.name: zotero_rename_tags
tools.title: Rename or merge Zotero tags
tools.description: Rename tags library-wide, keeping colors. Renaming multiple tags to one name (including an existing tag) merges them. Use zotero_update_items for specific items.

tools.name: zotero_delete_tags
tools.title: Delete Zotero tags
tools.description: Delete tags (and their colors) library-wide. Use zotero_update_items for specific items.

tools.name: zotero_set_tag_color
tools.title: Set a Zotero tag's color
tools.description: Set or remove a tag's color or number-key position (at most 9 colored tags per library).

color.description: Color name, null to remove, or omit to keep current color

position.description: Number key 1–9 (default: current or next free)

color.description: Color name or #rrggbb; absent if removed

tools.name: zotero_list_saved_searches
tools.title: List Zotero saved searches
tools.description: List saved searches with their conditions. Run one with zotero_search (savedSearchKey) or show it with zotero_select.

tools.name: zotero_add_saved_search
tools.title: Create a Zotero saved search
tools.description: Save conditions, as zotero_search takes them, as a saved search.

tools.name: zotero_update_saved_search
tools.title: Update a Zotero saved search
tools.description: Rename a saved search or replace its conditions. Use zotero_trash to delete.

conditions.description: Replaces existing conditions (same format as zotero_search)

tools.name: zotero_get_notes
tools.title: Get Zotero notes and annotations
tools.description: Get notes and reader annotations for items, attachments, notes or annotations. Rendered image/ink annotations include imagePath; render others with zotero_render_annotation_images. Note images appear as [image] in Markdown and in order in images.

itemKeys.description: Item, attachment, note or annotation keys

imagePath.description: Rendered PNG path (read now; replaced on edit)

tools.name: zotero_render_annotation_images
tools.title: Render Zotero annotation images
tools.description: Render PDF image/ink annotations to PNGs (for annotations without imagePath in zotero_get_notes). Rendering may continue after the call.

path.description: PNG path (read now; replaced on edit)

tools.name: zotero_add_note
tools.title: Add a Zotero note
tools.description: Add a Markdown note under a regular item, or standalone (optionally in a collection). Supports CommonMark, tables, ~~strikethrough~~ and TeX math ($…$ inline, $$ blocks; currency/plain $x$ stays text). Raw HTML is escaped; images become links.

markdown.description: First line becomes title; start with a heading

parentItem.description: Regular item key for a child note

tools.name: zotero_edit_note
tools.title: Edit a Zotero note
tools.description: Append Markdown to a note or replace it (same Markdown as zotero_add_note). For replace, requires dateModified from zotero_get_notes to prevent overwriting concurrent edits (optional for append, checked if given). Replacing refuses notes with highlights, citations or images; append instead.

mode.description: replace overwrites the whole note (first line becomes title)

tools.name: zotero_search_fulltext
tools.title: Search Zotero full text
tools.description: Search indexed full text of PDFs, EPUBs, snapshots and text files, returning matching passages with page/offset and open links. Word/phrase match (case/accent-insensitive, prefix-matching, not semantic); every term must appear. Ordered by item dateModified; PDFs default to first 100 indexed pages. Use zotero_read_text for more context, or zotero_search (fulltextContent) to combine with metadata.

query.description: Words and "quoted phrases", e.g. 'carbon "soil organic matter"'

itemKeys.description: Limit to these item/attachment keys. Not with collectionKey.

tools.name: zotero_read_text
tools.title: Read text from a Zotero file
tools.description: Read text from a PDF, EPUB, snapshot or text file. PDFs paginate by page (outline included on page 1); other files by character offset. Returns up to ~maxChars with nextPage/nextOffset.

itemKey.description: Attachment key, or item key for its best file

tools.name: zotero_find_fulltext_attachments
tools.title: Find full text attachments for Zotero items
tools.description: Run Zotero's Find Full Text on items without a PDF/EPUB (by DOI, URL or PMCID, using open-access and institutional access). Useful after zotero_import. Items already having a PDF/EPUB or lacking identifiers are skipped.

path.description: Local file path, if on this computer

tools.name: zotero_add_attachment
tools.title: Attach a file in Zotero
tools.description: Attach a local file or download a PDF/EPUB to an item. Without parentItem, adds a local file standalone and tries to identify it.

parentItem.description: Regular item key (omit for standalone local file)

url.description: http(s) PDF/EPUB or linking page (requires parentItem; not with path; uses institutional access)

linkFile.description: Link to path instead of copying (auto-renames on disk if enabled in Zotero)

collectionKey.description: Collection for standalone file (only without parentItem)

identification.description: Standalone only; absent once parent is created

path.description: Local file path, if on this computer

tools.name: zotero_trash
tools.title: Move to the Zotero trash
tools.description: Move items (with children), collections (with subcollections) or saved searches to the trash. Items in trashed collections stay in the library. Reversible via zotero_restore_from_trash.

tools.name: zotero_restore_from_trash
tools.title: Restore from the Zotero trash
tools.description: Restore trashed items, collections or saved searches along with their children/subcollections.

tools.name: zotero_get_context
tools.title: Get what the user is looking at in Zotero
tools.description: Get the active window's selection, open reader/note, and all windows/tabs. Tab IDs are only unique per window (e.g. zotero-pane); pass windowID too when ambiguous.

tabType.description: library, reader, note, etc., with -loading/-unloaded if not ready

selectedItems.description: Up to 50; only when library tab is active

path.description: Local file path, if on this computer

tools.name: zotero_select
tools.title: Show items in Zotero
tools.description: Show a library, collection or saved search in a library tab, selecting specific or all items (replaces any active search/tag filter; opens a window if needed). UI only.

collectionKey.description: Default: whole library. Not with savedSearchKey.

itemKeys.description: Items to select (must be in view; omit with allItems: false to clear selection)

allItems.description: Select all shown items. Not with itemKeys.

notShown.description: Keys not in the collection/saved search

tools.name: zotero_open
tools.title: Open a file or note in Zotero
tools.description: Open a PDF, EPUB, snapshot or note in Zotero, optionally scrolling to a page or annotation. Reuses an existing tab unless newTab is true. UI only.

itemKey.description: Attachment, note, or regular item (opens best file)

annotationKey.description: Annotation to scroll to and select

newTab.description: Open a new tab even if already open

tools.name: zotero_close
tools.title: Close Zotero tabs or windows
tools.description: Close tabs or windows by ID from zotero_get_context (reopenable via Reopen Closed Tab). Pinned tabs and the last tab (non-macOS) can't be closed.

tools.name: zotero_generate_citations
tools.title: Generate Zotero citations
tools.description: Format items in a CSL style as one citation, a bibliography, or (format: document) all citations + bibliography together with cross-document numbering, disambiguation and ibid./short forms. Standalone numeric citations always start at [1]. Use zotero_export for BibTeX/RIS. Uninstalled styles are installed from the Zotero Style Repository with permission.

items.description: For citation or bibliography, in order

citations.description: For document: ordered list of citation clusters

html.description: Return HTML instead of plain text

bibliography.description: For document; absent if style has none

tools.name: zotero_import
tools.title: Import into Zotero
tools.description: Import a local file or text (BibTeX, BibLaTeX, RIS, Zotero RDF, CSL JSON, MODS, EndNote XML, etc.). Referenced files are imported for path; file imports create a new collection unless collectionKey is given. Doesn't deduplicate.

path.description: Absolute file path. Not with text.

newCollection.description: Create a new collection (default: true for path, false for text)

linkFiles.description: Link referenced files instead of copying

tools.name: zotero_export
tools.title: Export from Zotero
tools.description: Export items, a collection or a library as text or to a file (BibTeX, BibLaTeX, RIS, Zotero RDF, CSL JSON, CSV, MODS, EndNote XML, Markdown/HTML for notes; unknown format lists all). Large exports require path.

itemKeys.description: Not with collectionKey; omit both for whole library

includeSubcollectionItems.description: Include subcollections at any depth (and export them in formats that keep collections)

path.description: Absolute path to write (asks permission; omit to return text)

includeFiles.description: Copy files and annotations; path becomes a new folder

overwrite.description: Replace existing file at path (never folders or includeFiles)

citationKeys.description: BibTeX/BibLaTeX (≤500 items): item key → citation key
